title: refactor(objectql): split registry.ts into section modules by codemod (split 1 of 8), a move with the public exports unchanged
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Part of #33949. This PR is split 1 of 8 under ruling item 1: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`. It also adds the split facade's line ceiling, as ruling item 2 and the ceiling gate from #34103 require. It follows the maintainer rule for splits (#33949 comment 6911407209): the split script is not committed, the PR body carries its proof readings, and the net growth is accounted for per file. The other seven splits stay open on the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 objectql 的 `registry.ts`(12,577 行)按章节拆成 13 个模块,`registry.ts` 留作转发入口,剩 6,326 行,并按裁决第 2 条给它登记行数上限 6,426(6,326 + 100)。对外导出一个不少,类型/值种类不变,只是代码搬家,不改任何行为。拆分脚本不进仓库,只留在本分支历史(`b89e3e42b8`)里供核验。
- 为什么改:落实 #33949 裁决第 1 条「热点文件逐个拆分,registry.ts 第一个」。这个文件是并发 PR 冲突最多的地方之一,拆开后各改各的模块。
- 风险与回滚:风险在「搬家是否真的一字不差」。历史里的脚本证明了两件事:200 个方法体和 127 个顶层声明与 main 上逐字节相同;`registry.ts` 的 68 个导出名与种类不变。净增约 2,650 行,下文「Growth account」逐文件列出来源。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① 下文「Growth account」表(净增从哪来);② `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` 新增的 1 行 facade、15 行例外(没搬的成员及原因)和 1 行上限;③ `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的转发形态。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支根目录执行 `git show b89e3e42b8:scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs > scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs; node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --verify --base $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main); echo exit=$?; rm scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs`。预期看到 `byte-identity: 200/200 … 127/127 … identical` 与 `exports-equality: equal`,外加恰好一行 ✗,说 `registry-facet-hosts.ts` 与生成稿不同,因此 exit=1。原因是该文件头注释在脚本删除后改了措辞,而脚本对这个文件做整文件比对;原因与对照证明见 Tests。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(超过 3,000 行),需要维护者批准合并。

## What changes

`registry.ts` is split by a codemod: pass 1 of the `engine.ts` split codemod, re-targeted at `SchemaRegistry`, plus an exports-equality proof. Following the maintainer rule, the script is **not** in this PR's tree. It lives in this branch's history: it was added in `4001a5c559`, last changed in `c92a4d31b4`, and deleted in `08a3d7ae79`. Read it with `git show b89e3e42b8:scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs` (blob `eb7cc556a0`). It has to run from the repo's `scripts/` directory, because it imports the sibling helpers `invoked-as.mjs` and `ts-parse.mjs` and resolves the repo root from its own path.

- **Facets.** 200 of the 215 class methods move to a facet class in one of 11 section modules. The section anchors are the existing section banners, so each module is one banner's methods. `SchemaRegistry` keeps every member's signature and docblock, and each moved method is a one-call stub: `Facet.name.call(FacetHost.of(this), …)`. `registry-facet-hosts.ts` declares a host per facet and the class installs them in a static block, so a facet reads private state only through its host.
- **Top level.** 127 of the 161 top-level declarations ahead of the class move whole into `registry-top-level.ts`. `registry.ts` re-exports by name every one it exported before.
- **Stays.** 15 methods and 34 top-level declarations stay in `registry.ts`. Each method that stays is a row in `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` `exceptions`, citing #33949 with its stay reason (bare `this`, inferred return type, a parameter that shadows a moved name, a computed name, the constructor). That is the same shape the `engine.ts` split left for its members pass.
- **Path readers.** Four declarations stay in `registry.ts` because a reader looks for them in that file by path: `mergeObjectDefinitions` and `isShareableNamespace` (ADR symbol anchors), `REGISTRY_LOG_LEVELS` (`check:registry-log-declared` and `check:rest-log-declared` read it from `registry.ts`), and `TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX` (an ADR-0117 `registry.ts#organization_id` token). So the ADRs and the two gates are untouched.
- **Facade registration.** `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` registers `registry.ts` / `SchemaRegistry` as a facade, so `check:facade-delegation-only` holds it to delegation from here on. `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS` in that gate names the file.
- **Line ceiling.** `ceilings` gains `{ file: registry.ts, baseLines: 6326, baseCommit: c27f4ab0d6, maxLines: 6426, ruling: 6897467376 }`. `c27f4ab0d6` is the regeneration commit: the merge of origin/main `f9120b8692`, with the split regenerated on it. The rewording commit changed no line of `registry.ts` (still 6,326 lines), so the row stands.
- **Wording.** The 13 module headers, the changeset and the 15 `exceptions` reasons cite "the #33949 split codemod (PR #34285, kept in its branch history, not committed)" instead of a script path. They change comments and text only: across `packages/objectql/src`, 36 changed lines between `b89e3e42b8` and this head, every one a `*` or `//` comment line.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/objectql` patch, a move only.

### Growth account

The diff is +9,762 / −7,105, a net of **+2,657**. Per file (`git diff --numstat $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD`):

| part | added | removed | net |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `registry.ts`, the facade side: stubs, section comments, imports, the re-export list, the static host block | 849 | 7,100 | −6,251 |
| the 13 new modules (moved text plus their overhead, table below) | 8,780 | 0 | +8,780 |
| `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` (1 facade row, 15 exception rows, 1 ceiling row) | 117 | 0 | +117 |
| `.changeset/33949-registry-split.md` | 10 | 0 | +10 |
| `scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` (one watch hint) | 1 | 0 | +1 |
| `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` (5 keys re-keyed) | 5 | 5 | 0 |
| **total** | **9,762** | **7,105** | **+2,657** |

So the split code itself grows by +2,529 (8,780 − 6,251):

- **Facade stubs: +849.** These are all the lines added to `registry.ts`. The codemod's own plan counts 800 of them as stub lines (each moved method keeps its signature, gains a marker comment and becomes a one-call forward) and 22 as import lines; the rest are section comments, the re-export list and the static host block. The plan reading is `total: 200/215 methods move into 11 module(s): 3799 body lines out, 800 stub lines in, plus 22 import lines`.
- **Module overhead: +1,680.** This is the module lines minus the lines `registry.ts` gave up (8,780 − 7,100). Per module, the lines that are not moved text are 1,818: 459 header lines, 156 import lines and 1,203 lines of facet wrapper, duplicated signatures (a facet's static method repeats the signature the stub keeps) and the host interfaces. Against that, 138 lines deleted from `registry.ts` reappear in no module (mostly the blank and signature lines the stubs replace). 1,818 − 138 = 1,680.

| module | lines | moved text | header | imports | wrapper, signatures, host, blank | growth |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `registry-apps.ts` | 216 | 145 | 33 | 3 | 35 | 71 |
| `registry-bare-names.ts` | 377 | 290 | 37 | 8 | 42 | 87 |
| `registry-facet-hosts.ts` | 69 | 10 | 19 | 12 | 28 | 59 |
| `registry-items.ts` | 351 | 265 | 34 | 12 | 40 | 86 |
| `registry-namespaces-and-claims.ts` | 520 | 400 | 41 | 14 | 65 | 120 |
| `registry-object-registration.ts` | 1,638 | 1,375 | 47 | 30 | 186 | 263 |
| `registry-package-addressing.ts` | 832 | 669 | 41 | 15 | 107 | 163 |
| `registry-packages.ts` | 709 | 564 | 38 | 15 | 92 | 145 |
| `registry-picklists.ts` | 505 | 341 | 41 | 9 | 114 | 164 |
| `registry-platform-global.ts` | 764 | 575 | 43 | 7 | 139 | 189 |
| `registry-restore.ts` | 363 | 244 | 37 | 9 | 73 | 119 |
| `registry-storage.ts` | 187 | 100 | 34 | 3 | 50 | 87 |
| `registry-top-level.ts` | 2,249 | 1,984 | 14 | 19 | 232 | 265 |
| **total** | **8,780** | **6,962** | **459** | **156** | **1,203** | **1,818** |

<details><summary>How each figure was counted</summary>

- The per-file added/removed lines and the total come from `git diff --numstat $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD`.
- The module table comes from the script below, run from the repo root.
  - **header** is the lines before the first `import`.
  - **imports** is the lines inside `import` statements.
  - **moved text** is the module lines that match, as a multiset, a line deleted from `registry.ts` in `git diff MERGE_BASE HEAD -- packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`.
  - **wrapper, signatures, host, blank** is everything else.
  - The multiset match is per line, so a common line such as `  }` can be credited to whichever module meets it first. The per-module split of moved text against overhead is approximate. The totals are exact.
- The stub reading is the codemod's plan output on `f9120b8692`'s `registry.ts`, from the history copy of the script.

```python
# save as growth.py, then run: python3 growth.py $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
import subprocess, sys, collections
mb = sys.argv[1]
git = lambda *a: subprocess.run(['git', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
src = 'packages/objectql/src/'
d = git('diff', mb, 'HEAD', '--', src + 'registry.ts').splitlines()
deleted = collections.Counter(l[1:] for l in d if l.startswith('-') and not l.startswith('---'))
mods = sorted(f for f in git('diff', '--name-only', '--diff-filter=A', mb, 'HEAD', '--', src).split() if not f.endswith('.test.ts'))
for f in mods:
    lines = open(f).read().split('\n')[:-1]
    first = next((i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('import ')), len(lines))
    imports = moved = other = 0; in_imp = False
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if i < first: continue
        if l.startswith('import ') or in_imp:
            imports += 1; in_imp = not l.rstrip().endswith(';'); continue
        if deleted[l] > 0: deleted[l] -= 1; moved += 1
        else: other += 1
    print(f, len(lines), moved, first, imports, other, len(lines) - moved)
print('deleted from registry.ts, found in no module:', sum(deleted.values()))
```

</details>

### Open PRs that touch `registry.ts`

Measured at 2026-11-16T05:51Z over all 62 open PRs, through the paginated REST files list: no open PR other than this one touches `registry.ts`.

Earlier overlaps are all already inside the split. #34036 (+45 / −1) merged at 19:50Z, #34156 (+73 / −7) at 01:46Z, and #34224 (+31 / −2) after that. The split is regenerated on origin/main `f9120b8692`, which contains all three.

## Tests

### The split's proofs (the script from branch history)

**Last run with the script in the tree**, on `b89e3e42b8`, from the repo root:

```text
$ node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --verify --base $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)    # f9120b8692
byte-identity: 200/200 moved bodies identical to base (body, parameters, return type, async); 127/127 moved top-level declarations identical to base (leading comments included); registry.ts 12577 -> 6326 lines; undoing the split does rebuild the base byte-for-byte once the 63 import binding(s) only moved text reads are pruned from the base (…63 names…)
exports-equality: equal — registry.ts exports 68 name(s) at base (55 value(s), 13 type(s)); the split exports every one, each the same kind, plus 10 generated name(s) (lever (a), the statics route) (NOT_A_PAIR_ROW_OF_A_HOLDER, RegistrationRestorePoint, TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX, ValidationRuleCopyRefusedError, actionHoldersOnOwnerKeyOf, declaredOverrideBase, isShareableNamespace, mergeObjectDefinitions, pairRowDeclaresAnotherHolder, provisionTenantScopeIndex), which no module re-exports with `export *`
exit 0

$ node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --self-test
✓ codemod-split-registry self-test: 74 cases in 7 batteries pass.

```

**Re-run on this head (`e06e1a9d53`, after the deletion and the rewording)**, with the history copy put back at `scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs` for the run and removed afterwards. Its blob is `eb7cc556a0`, the same bytes as above.

```text

$ node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --verify --base $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)    # f9120b8692
```

**What the proof compares and what it ignores, plainly:**

- `registry.ts` is checked whole: undoing the split must rebuild the base byte for byte. The rewording changed no line of it.
- Each facet module is checked on its facet class: every static method must be a moved body, byte-identical. The text outside that class is not compared: the header comment, the imports and the host interface.
- The leaf module `registry-top-level.ts` is checked statement by statement: each moved declaration, with its leading comments, must be byte-identical. The header comment before the first statement is not compared.
- `registry-facet-hosts.ts` is compared **whole** against what the script generates. So the reworded header comment of that file is the one ✗ above.

**Control leg.** On the same head, with only `registry-facet-hosts.ts` put back to its `b89e3e42b8` bytes (blob `9b780d1060`; its diff to this head is the 3-line header comment and nothing else), the same command gives `exit 0`. The file was then restored to `HEAD` (blob `8cca5ac880`), and `git diff HEAD` was empty. So the twelve other reworded headers are outside what the proof compares, and the one ✗ is that header and nothing else.

### Ablation of the exports-equality proof (a reading against the history sha)

The ablation was run while the script was in the tree, on the same blob `eb7cc556a0` that `git show b89e3e42b8:scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs` returns today. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restore was proven blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

### Package tests

- **objectql**, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 599/599 test files and 13,366/13,366 tests pass on `b89e3e42b8` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). The commits after it change comments, text and the deleted script only.
- **Direct dependents** (11 packages: cli, cloud-connection, plugin-audit, plugin-dev, plugin-email, plugin-pinyin-search, plugin-sharing, plugin-webhooks, runtime, service-automation, verify). Typecheck passes on `b89e3e42b8` for objectql and all 11 (75/75 tasks). Their tests ran on the earlier split heads `3683e1eb53` and `537121403d`: the runtime suite, and the cli unit tier (`--project unit`) at 423/423 files and 6,010/6,010 tests. This is a declared narrowing; CI runs them in full.
- **One test changed.** `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys each reader as `FILE#FUNCTION :: column`. Five keys follow their function to its new file: three to `registry-top-level.ts` and two to `registry-platform-global.ts`. The `organization_id` row stays at `registry.ts`, where `TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX` is pinned. No assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The members pass.** The 15 `exceptions` rows are first-pass stays, as on `engine.ts`. A members pass that moves them is a separate card, not this PR.
- **The script.** Following the maintainer rule, no split script merges. The four `codemod-split-*.mjs` scripts already on main are removed by #34345, not here.

## Verification

Head `e06e1a9d53`. It is the regeneration merge `c27f4ab0d6` (origin/main `f9120b8692`) plus three commits: the ceiling row (`b89e3e42b8`), the script's deletion (`08a3d7ae79`) and the comment-only rewording (`e06e1a9d53`).

**On `b89e3e42b8`** (the last code change; the two later commits change comments, text and the deleted script only), all under os-verify-lock with VERDICT command-exit 0:

- objectql tests: 599/599 files, 13,366/13,366 tests.
- typecheck of objectql and its 11 direct dependents: 75/75 tasks.
- `pnpm check:facade-delegation-only`: self-test 44 cases, then the gate. It reads `registry.ts: 6326 lines, ceiling 6426 (100 left)`.
- The dispatch-gates union: 93 families, every one exit 0, reconciled as `93 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- CI on `b89e3e42b8`: 51 check-runs, 35 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure.

**On `e06e1a9d53`:** NOT MEASURED. A maintainer order (09:01Z) stopped the run before it got the verify lock. These gates were not run on this head: objectql typecheck, `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts`, `check:facade-delegation-only`, `check:adr-symbol-anchors`, eslint on the touched files, and the dispatch-gates union. Derived for this head, the union is the same 93 families as on `b89e3e42b8`. What was run on this head is the split proof in Tests: byte-identity 200/200 and 127/127, exports-equality equal over 68 names. Also a check that every changed line in `packages/objectql/src` since `b89e3e42b8` is a comment line (36 lines, 0 non-comment). CI on this head is the reading to take.
